about_the_game: You are crash-landed in the Endless Vine, a huge uncharted jungle. Starting with nothing, you must establish a thriving colony, rescue fellow survivors, and build the technology needed to escape the hostile wilderness. Each survivor you rescue makes your colony a little stronger and more prepared. House and feed them, and put them to work in your workshops, or send them on expeditions to gather resources or find more survivors. Keep up colony morale and be ready to defend when raiders attack. Progress through multiple technology tiers starting from primitive tools and progressing through to industrial steam power. Build a steam engine that powers machinery, turrets, traps, and more. Establish farms, cook meals, and manage your settlement's needs. Explore the infinite jungle and explore loot-filled caves, savage tribal forts, and discover what lurks in the wild. Face savage warriors, mechanical automatons, and savage beasts as you build toward your ultimate goal of constructing a vehicle capable of flying you to freedom.

short_description: Crash-landed in an endless jungle with only your colony banner, you must rescue survivors, build a steam-powered settlement, and construct an escape vehicle before the wilderness claims you. Endless Vine is a steampunk survival colony builder where every decision shapes your fight for survival.
